title: Internet Users Are Crackin' UP At Blue Ivy's Apparent Reaction To Her Team Directing Her While She Posed On Met Gala Red Carpet (WATCH) - NewsBreak
text:
By Jadriena Solomon ,
9 hours ago Internet users are crackin’ UP at Blue Ivy ‘s apparent reaction to her team directing her while she posed for photos on the Met Gala red carpet.
RELATED: Bow Down! 7 Times Blue Ivy Carter Served Peak Capricorn Energy And Gave Us Manager Vibes More On Blue Ivy’s Apparent Reaction To Her Team Directing Her While She Posed For Photos On Met Gala Red Carpet On Tuesday, May 5, The Shade Room reposted footage recorded of Blue Ivy’s time walking on the Met Gala red carpet. In the clip, Blue posed alongside her mom for photos while her mom’s bodyguard, their publicist, and Jay-Z himself all motioned for her to take off her sunglasses.
As the cameras snapped, Blue seemed reluctant to do so, and she held her pose — glasses and all.
Internet Users Are Crackin’ UP Internet users entered TSR’s comment section , crackin’ UP at Blue Ivy’s apparent reaction — or lack thereof — to her team.
Instagram user @soprettidrea wrote, “ Somebody said beyonce was standing there not saything nothing like she was in the elevator lol” While Instagram user @natali .t added, “ Blue said yall work for me! I don’t work for you 😭” Instagram user @blackadventuremom wrote, “ How many times did they think they needed to tell her. 😂😂😂 the answer was no.”
While Instagram user @precilla_tshabalala added, “ Blue said ‘Try me because I’ll take Beyonce home’ 😂😂😂😭👍🏽” Instagram user @dami.adei wrote, “ I love how Beyonce didn’t interfere and allowed Blue to do what makes her comfortable” While Instagram user @stephaniedillard18 added, “ B ybae can’t nobody ignore you like A TEENAGER! 😂” Instagram user @cobacobana wrote, “ Blue is the program, they seem to forget” While Instagram user @a_rose_in_harlem_35 added, “ Baby!!!! Blue is gonna be NOTHING TO PLAY WITH in 10 more years.” Instagram user @queenmelanin_ty wrote, “ All them damn lights in her face! She said what she said!! Wait!” While Instagram user @thebadpapi added, “ She saw them 😂. It’s Blue she ain’t miss nothing – she PAID it dust & threw literal shade 😂” Instagram user @ms.business101 wrote, “ I loved the look even more with the shades. Yassss blu, I see the vision.”
While Instagram user @hot_nai added, “ Blue is such a boss. She knows what she wants.🔥😍 She looks absolutely stunning” More On Blue Ivy’s Appearance On The Met Gala Red Carpet As The Shade Room previously reported, Blue Ivy appeared alongside her parents on the Met Gala red carpet on Monday, May 4. Per PEOPLE , the occasion was Blue’s first time on the carpet, and she donned a “monochromatic white strapless Balenciaga gown with a billowing skirt and train.”
“I think she looks so incredible,” Beyoncé reportedly told Vogue about her daughter.
RELATED: That’s Me Right There! Jay-Z And Beyoncé React To Blue Ivy’s Met Gala Debut As Fans Are In Awe (VIDEOS) The post appeared first on .
